nodes.label: Architecture Decisions
nodes.rationale: TypeScript/Node 22 is the fastest path at this budget (Rust not worth the hours); stdio transport gives simplest client config with no network surface; node:http with socketPath because the daemon is HTTP over a Unix socket; no streaming because no push transport exists (coven-relay is a stub); Windows and semantic memory are out of scope because named-pipe transport is undocumented and coven-memory is unreachable over the socket.

nodes.label: Known Traps
nodes.rationale: Fifteen pre-loaded upstream quirks (mixed casing conventions, double-encoded payload_json, raw PTY output, undocumented kill event, 4 MiB socket body cap, bare-array/envelope pagination, resume tokens dying on MCP client restarts) recorded so they are not rediscovered as bugs during the build window.

nodes.label: V1 Tool Surface
nodes.rationale: Nine tools locked to daemon routes; token streaming, Windows, semantic memory search, hub/scheduler/travel routes, and POST /actions explicitly cut because honest scope reads as maturity.

nodes.label: Security Design
nodes.rationale: The daemon has no authentication, so the MCP server inherits full same-user authority; most entrants will ship this unguarded, so ~2 hours of allowlist gating, fail-loud misconfiguration, excerpt redaction, and a documented threat model buys both the security score and differentiation.

nodes.label: Checkpoint A
nodes.rationale: Hard abort gate at ~6h: a bridge that half-connects scores below a linter that works, so failure means immediate descope to the Familiar Contract validator rather than pushing through.

nodes.label: Descope Ladder
nodes.rationale: Ordered cuts if behind schedule: memory tool first, then event accumulation (return raw events), then write tools (ship a read-only observability bridge that still demos, is still novel, and still honest).

nodes.label: Freeze Checklist
nodes.rationale: Friday is freeze day, not build day; scripts/freeze-preflight.mjs mechanizes the checklist because a wrong tag name is unrecoverable after the deadline.

nodes.label: Documentation Contract
nodes.rationale: The official submission guide specifies 14 exact README section headings in order; npm run verify enforces them mechanically so the docs check can never silently drift from the guide.
